description: Claude's usage command reads the bound account's allowance and grants, then reads its organization profile and prepaid credits on the same transport.

executables.claude:
[[ "$#" == 1 && "$1" == --version ]]
if [[ ${FIXTURE_VERSION_EXIT:-0} != 0 ]]; then exit 127; fi
printf '%s\n' "${FIXTURE_VERSION:-9.8.7 (Claude Code)}"
